study type: descriptive correlation study with a cross-sectional approach
cohort: 60 mothers who delivered by C-section using the ERACS method at Aisyiyah Muntilan Hospital.
finding: There was a difference in milk production between patients who received the anesthetic combination of vopicain, fentanyl, and dexmedetomidine and those who received vopicain and morphine.
mod_finding: A difference in milk production was observed between mothers receiving different anesthetic combinations during C-section delivery.
